summary: Iteration 14 tested floorplan zone editor + event-detail floorplan breakout. Backend: 3/3 pytest passed AFTER a 1-line patcher fix — GET /api/settings returns 3 floorplan_zones (STAGE/RIVA/BAR) with all keys (id,label,color,price_from,min_spend,bottles,description) populated; PUT /api/admin/settings partial update with floorplan_zones array replaces the list and persists on subsequent GET; STAGE modification verified and restored. Frontend event detail (/eventi/{fp_event_id}): [data-testid=floorplan-section] renders 1360px wide vs parent 1152px (breakout margins work). 3 zone cards (floorplan-zone-card-STAGE/RIVA/BAR) render with price_from and bottles text visible. Clicking a floorplan-table opens booking-modal which shows booking-zone-info with the zone's price/bottles/description text. CRITICAL: Admin Contenuti tab is MISSING the entire floorplan-editor block — [data-testid=floorplan-editor] not present, and none of the per-zone rows/inputs (floorplan-zone-{ZID}, floorplan-{ZID}-label/color/price/min/bottles/desc) exist in AdminDashboard.jsx. saveSettings payload does forward floorplan_zones to backend, but there is no UI to edit them.

minor.issue: Original patcher backfilled only home_/about_/contact_ prefixes; floorplan_zones was empty in DB. Fixed inline by adding or key.startswith('floorplan_') so the 3 default zones are backfilled automatically on next backend start.

ui_bugs.component: AdminDashboard Contenuti tab — floorplan editor block
ui_bugs.issue: The entire floorplan editor UI is missing. No [data-testid=floorplan-editor], no floorplan-zone-{STAGE|RIVA|BAR} rows, no floorplan-{ZID}-label/color/price/min/bottles/desc inputs. AdminDashboard.jsx saveSettings correctly forwards floorplan_zones from settings state, but no editable form exists to modify them. Admin has NO way to edit table zone info (prices/bottles/descriptions) from the UI — one of the two headline features of this iteration is unimplemented in the admin dashboard.

action_items: Add the missing floorplan-editor block to AdminDashboard.jsx Contenuti tab: render 3 zone rows for STAGE/RIVA/BAR each with editable inputs (label, color, price_from, min_spend, bottles, description). Inputs must have data-testid=floorplan-{ZID}-{label|color|price|min|bottles|desc} and rows data-testid=floorplan-zone-{ZID}, wrapped by data-testid=floorplan-editor. The saveSettings payload already includes floorplan_zones, so only UI wiring is needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1216 startup patcher enumerated only home_/about_/contact_ prefixes and silently skipped floorplan_zones — patched to include floorplan_ prefix. Consider a whitelist-by-key approach (list of backfill-eligible keys) to avoid future misses when new prefixes are added.

AdminDashboard saveSettings on line ~188 maps floorplan_zones but there is no UI producing/mutating settings.floorplan_zones state — meaning the payload always reflects whatever came from GET /api/settings, effectively a no-op round-trip until an editor is added.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (startup patcher: added floorplan_ prefix to backfill list)
